title: Stop interpolating e.toString() directly into tutoring error/snackbar text
why: manage_grants_screen.dart and manage_tutors_screen.dart interpolate a raw Dart exception's toString() into an otherwise-localized ARB string 4 times, so a Hebrew UI sentence ends with an untranslated English/technical fragment (e.g. a gRPC status string). The 6 matching data-layer sites (firestore_tutor_grant_repository.dart x6, tutor_write_service.dart x1) manufacture that raw string in the first place by stuffing `e.toString()` into the Failure.message field instead of a stable code, which is exactly the custom_lint `no_e_to_string_in_ui` rule this repo already has defined (currently non-enforcing because custom_lint is broken repo-wide).
recommendation: In the 4 UI catch blocks, map to a generic localized fallback (as invite_tutor_screen.dart already does for TutorGrantFailure) instead of interpolating e.toString(); in the data layer, log e.toString() via AppLogger and return a stable failure code instead of stashing the raw text in the value the UI eventually reads.
acceptance_criteria: grep -rn 'e.toString()' lib/features/tutoring/presentation/ returns no UI-text interpolation sites.
Widget test confirms a thrown exception during revoke/rescind/load shows a fixed localized string regardless of the exception's message.

corrections: The lint source (packages/custom_lints/lib/src/rules/no_e_to_string_in_ui.dart) scopes strictly to files under '/presentation/'. It would NOT catch the 7 data-layer sites (data/repositories, data/services) even if custom_lint worked — only the 4 UI sites are covered by that specific lint. The 'why' text's claim that data-layer sites are 'exactly' this lint is inaccurate; those sites are EH-5 violations only. Doesn't change validity/severity of the underlying finding.
